note: The forward dividend table of H7 (FORWARD_RULE_H7.md section 2) and H9 (PREREG_H9.md section 2), read by forward_h7_h9.py. Per name: 'ex' holds every cash distribution whose ex-date is on or after 2026-10-23, keyed by ex-date, each with its amount per share (null until the fund declares it) and its source; 'complete_through' is the last date through which the table is CLAIMED complete (every ex-date on or before it is listed). A forward row that needs the dividend of a date after complete_through, or of a listed ex-date whose amount is still null, FAILS LOUDLY and waits; a dividend is never taken as 0 for want of a row. To extend it: read the issuer's declaration (SPY: State Street's SPDR distribution page, https://www.ssga.com/us/en/intermediary/etfs/spdr-sp-500-etf-trust-spy, its 'ETF Historical Distributions'; QQQ: Invesco's QQQ distribution page or Nasdaq's dividend history, https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/etf/qqq/dividend-history, H1's QQQ source), add each declared ex-date with its amount and the page, then move complete_through, in one commit (`forward_h7_h9.py dividends --add NAME EXDATE AMOUNT --source URL` and `--through NAME DATE` write the file and check it). No UW route on the plan carries distributions (/api/companies/{ticker}/dividends is marked 'Requires Advanced+ tier' in UW's own catalogue, and no Advanced plan is recorded for the job's token — research_notes/Compass features/INVENTORY.md B1 calls the research token an API trial; no token was in this workspace to try it), so the table is kept by hand. Set on 2026-10-23: no distribution with an ex-date from 2026-10-23 is listed. complete_through 2026-12-11 for both names rests on the funds' record, not on a declaration: every SPY ex-date in H1's table (56, 2012-03-16 to 2025-12-19) is the third Friday of March, June, September or December, and every QQQ ex-date (61, 2012-03-16 to 2026-09-21) falls between the 14th and the 24th of those months except 2014-02-27 and 2023-12-27; the next of each is due in the week of 2026-12-14 (SPY's third Friday 2026-12-18; QQQ's Monday after it, 2026-12-21, as in 2025-12-22 and 2026-09-21). An off-cycle QQQ distribution before 2026-12-11 would be missed by this claim; the claim stops before the December window so that a declaration must be read before any row past 2026-12-11 is computed.
